<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages;

use App\Models\Activity;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Forms\Components\DatePicker;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Form;
use Filament\Forms\Set;
use Filament\Pages\Dashboard as BaseDashboard;
use Filament\Pages\Dashboard\Concerns\HasFiltersForm;

/**
 * Dashboard con filtro per periodo, condiviso da tutti i widget.
 */
class Dashboard extends BaseDashboard
{
    use HasFiltersForm {
        mountHasFilters as baseMountHasFilters;
    }

    /**
     * Livewire chiama il mount() esplicito del componente PRIMA degli hook
     * mount{Trait} (qui mountHasFilters, che ripristina i filtri dalla sessione/URL):
     * un mount() separato vedrebbe sempre $this->filters ancora vuoto e
     * sovrascriverebbe ogni personalizzazione ad ogni reload. Sovrascrivendo
     * direttamente mountHasFilters possiamo invocare prima il comportamento
     * originale del trait e solo dopo, se i campi risultano ancora vuoti,
     * applicare i default pre-calcolati (Filament applica il default di un
     * campo solo al primissimo fill "da zero": se la sessione contiene già
     * un filtro esplicito, anche vuoto, il default del campo non scatta più).
     */
    public function mountHasFilters(): void
    {
        $this->baseMountHasFilters();

        if (filled($this->filters['startDate'] ?? null) || filled($this->filters['endDate'] ?? null)) {
            return;
        }

        $range = $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange();

        $this->filters['startDate'] = $range->min;
        $this->filters['endDate'] = $range->max;

        $this->getFiltersForm()->fill($this->filters);

        if ($this->persistsFiltersInSession()) {
            session()->put($this->getFiltersSessionKey(), $this->filters);
        }
    }

    public function filtersForm(Form $form): Form
    {
        return $form
            ->schema([
                Select::make('preset')
                    ->label('Periodo rapido')
                    ->placeholder('Personalizzato')
                    ->options([
                        'all' => 'Tutte',
                        'current_week' => 'Settimana corrente',
                        'current_month' => 'Mese corrente',
                        'current_year' => 'Anno corrente',
                        'last_7_days' => 'Ultimi 7 giorni',
                        'last_30_days' => 'Ultimi 30 giorni',
                        'last_year' => 'Ultimo anno',
                    ])
                    ->live()
                    ->afterStateUpdated(function (?string $state, Set $set) {
                        if ($state === null) {
                            return;
                        }

                        [$start, $end] = $this->getPresetRange($state);

                        $set('startDate', $start);
                        $set('endDate', $end);

                        // riportato a null subito dopo l'uso: se restasse valorizzato,
                        // riselezionare la stessa voce (es. da uno stato in sessione
                        // rimasto identico) non genererebbe un cambio di stato e il
                        // preset non verrebbe più riapplicato
                        $set('preset', null);
                    })
                    ->columnSpanFull(),

                DatePicker::make('startDate')
                    ->label('Data inizio')
                    ->default(fn () => $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->min)
                    ->maxDate(fn (callable $get) => $get('endDate') ?: now())
                    // modifica manuale = non è più uno dei preset rapidi
                    ->afterStateUpdated(fn (Set $set) => $set('preset', null))
                    ->live(),

                DatePicker::make('endDate')
                    ->label('Data fine')
                    ->default(fn () => $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->max)
                    ->minDate(fn (callable $get) => $get('startDate'))
                    ->maxDate(now())
                    ->afterStateUpdated(fn (Set $set) => $set('preset', null))
                    ->live()
                    ->suffixAction(
                        Action::make('reset')
                            ->label('Reimposta')
                            ->icon('heroicon-m-arrow-path')
                            ->action(function (Set $set) {
                                $range = $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange();

                                $set('preset', null);
                                $set('startDate', Carbon::parse($range->min)->toDateString());
                                $set('endDate', Carbon::parse($range->max)->toDateString());
                            }),
                        isInline: true,
                    ),
            ])
            ->columns(2);
    }

    /**
     * Estremi (data inizio, data fine) di un preset rapido.
     *
     * @return array{0: string, 1: string}
     */
    protected function getPresetRange(string $preset): array
    {
        $now = Carbon::now();

        return match ($preset) {
            'all' => [
                Carbon::parse($this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->min)->toDateString(),
                Carbon::parse($this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->max)->toDateString(),
            ],
            // la settimana comincia di domenica
            'current_week' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfWeek(Carbon::SUNDAY)->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->startOfWeek(Carbon::SUNDAY)->addDays(6)->toDateString(),
            ],
            'current_month' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfMonth()->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->endOfMonth()->toDateString(),
            ],
            'current_year' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfYear()->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->endOfYear()->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_7_days' => [
                $now->copy()->subDays(6)->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_30_days' => [
                $now->copy()->subDays(29)->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_year' => [
                $now->copy()->subYear()->addDay()->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
        };
    }

    /**
     * Data della prima e dell'ultima attività registrata dall'utente,
     * usate come estremi preimpostati del filtro periodo.
     */
    protected function getUserActivitiesDateRange(): object
    {
        return once(fn () => Activity::query()
            ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->selectRaw('min(start_date_local) as min, max(start_date_local) as max')
            ->first());
    }
}

{
    use InteractsWithPageFilters;

    protected static ?string $heading = 'Attività';

    protected int|string|array $columnSpan = 'full';

    protected static ?int $sort = 1;

    /**
     * Cambiando il periodo si torna alla prima pagina, altrimenti si
     * potrebbe restare su una pagina che con il nuovo filtro non esiste più.
     */
    public function updatedFilters(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    public function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->query($this->getActivitiesQuery())
            ->defaultSort('start_date_local', 'desc')
            ->paginated([10, 25, 50, 100])
            ->defaultPaginationPageOption(10)
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('start_date_local')
                    ->label('Data')
                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i')
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('name')
                    ->label('Nome')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->wrap(),

                Tables\Columns\IconColumn::make('type')
                    ->label('Tipo')
                    // icona e colore arrivano da ActivityType (HasIcon/HasColor), l'etichetta va nel tooltip
                    ->tooltip(fn (?Activity $record): ?string => $record?->type?->getLabel())
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('distance')
                    ->label('Distanza')
                    // i metri arrivano da Strava, li mostro in km
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => number_format(($state ?? 0) / 1000, 2, ',', '.').' km')
                    ->alignEnd()
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('moving_time')
                    ->label('Tempo')
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => $this->formatDuration($state))
                    ->alignEnd()
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('total_elevation_gain')
                    ->label('Dislivello')
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => number_format((int) $state, 0, ',', '.').' m')
                    ->alignEnd()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->toggleable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('average_speed')
                    ->label('Vel. media')
                    // unità dipendente dal tipo (passo per le attività a piedi, km/h per le altre)
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?float $state, Activity $record): string => $this->formatSpeed($state, $record))
                    ->alignEnd()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->toggleable(),
            ])
            ->actions([
                ViewAction::make()
                    ->slideOver()
                    ->infolist(fn (Infolist $infolist): Infolist => $infolist->schema([
                        Section::make()
                            ->columns(2)
                            ->schema([
                                TextEntry::make('name')
                                    ->label('Nome')
                                    ->columnSpanFull(),

                                TextEntry::make('type')
                                    ->label('Tipo')
                                    ->badge(),

                                TextEntry::make('start_date_local')
                                    ->label('Data e ora')
                                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i'),

                                TextEntry::make('distance')
                                    ->label('Distanza')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => number_format(($state ?? 0) / 1000, 2, ',', '.').' km'),

                                TextEntry::make('total_elevation_gain')
                                    ->label('Dislivello')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => number_format((int) $state, 0, ',', '.').' m'),

                                TextEntry::make('moving_time')
                                    ->label('Tempo in movimento')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => $this->formatDuration($state)),

                                TextEntry::make('elapsed_time')
                                    ->label('Tempo totale')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => $this->formatDuration($state)),

                                TextEntry::make('average_speed')
                                    ->label('Vel. media')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?float $state, Activity $record): string => $this->formatSpeed($state, $record)),

                                TextEntry::make('max_speed')
                                    ->label('Vel. massima')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?float $state, Activity $record): string => $this->formatSpeed($state, $record)),

                                TextEntry::make('gear_id')
                                    ->label('Attrezzatura')
                                    ->placeholder('—'),

                                TextEntry::make('calories')
                                    ->label('Calorie')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?float $state): ?string => $state ? number_format($state, 0, ',', '.').' kcal' : null)
                                    ->placeholder('—'),
                            ]),
                    ])),
            ]);
    }

    protected function getActivitiesQuery(): Builder
    {
        return Activity::query()
            ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->when(
                $this->filters['startDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '>=', $date)
            )
            ->when(
                $this->filters['endDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '<=', $date)
            );
    }

    private function formatDuration(?int $seconds): string
    {
        $seconds ??= 0;

        return gmdate($seconds >= 3600 ? 'H:i:s' : 'i:s', $seconds);
    }

    private function formatSpeed(?float $metersPerSecond, ?Activity $record): string
    {
        return $record?->type?->formatSpeed($metersPerSecond)
            ?? SpeedUnit::KilometersPerHour->format($metersPerSecond);
    }
}

class AdminPanelProvider extends PanelProvider
{
    public function panel(Panel $panel): Panel
    {
        return $panel
            ->default()
            ->id('admin')
            ->path('admin')
            ->login()
            ->passwordReset()
            ->colors([
                'primary' => Color::Amber,
            ])
            ->discoverResources(in: app_path('Filament/Resources'), for: 'App\\Filament\\Resources')
            ->discoverPages(in: app_path('Filament/Pages'), for: 'App\\Filament\\Pages')
            ->pages([

{
    use HasFiltersForm {
        mountHasFilters as baseMountHasFilters;
    }

    /**
     * Livewire chiama il mount() esplicito del componente PRIMA degli hook

     * un filtro esplicito, anche vuoto, il default del campo non scatta più).

    public function mountHasFilters(): void
    {
        $this->baseMountHasFilters();

        if (filled($this->filters['startDate'] ?? null) || filled($this->filters['endDate'] ?? null)) {
            return;
        }

        $range = $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange();

        $this->filters['startDate'] = $range->min;
        $this->filters['endDate'] = $range->max;

        $this->getFiltersForm()->fill($this->filters);

        if ($this->persistsFiltersInSession()) {
            session()->put($this->getFiltersSessionKey(), $this->filters);
        }
    }

    public function filtersForm(Form $form): Form
    {
        return $form
            ->schema([
                Select::make('preset')
                    ->label('Periodo rapido')
                    ->placeholder('Personalizzato')
                    ->options([
                        'all' => 'Tutte',
                        'current_week' => 'Settimana corrente',
                        'current_month' => 'Mese corrente',
                        'current_year' => 'Anno corrente',
                        'last_7_days' => 'Ultimi 7 giorni',
                        'last_30_days' => 'Ultimi 30 giorni',
                        'last_year' => 'Ultimo anno',
                    ])
                    ->live()
                    ->afterStateUpdated(function (?string $state, Set $set) {
                        if ($state === null) {
                            return;
                        }

                        [$start, $end] = $this->getPresetRange($state);

                        $set('startDate', $start);
                        $set('endDate', $end);

                        // riportato a null subito dopo l'uso: se restasse valorizzato,
                        // riselezionare la stessa voce (es. da uno stato in sessione
                        // rimasto identico) non genererebbe un cambio di stato e il
                        // preset non verrebbe più riapplicato
                        $set('preset', null);
                    })
                    ->columnSpanFull(),

                DatePicker::make('startDate')
                    ->label('Data inizio')
                    ->default(fn () => $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->min)
                    ->maxDate(fn (callable $get) => $get('endDate') ?: now())
                    // modifica manuale = non è più uno dei preset rapidi
                    ->afterStateUpdated(fn (Set $set) => $set('preset', null))
                    ->live(),

                    ->label('Data fine')
                    ->default(fn () => $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->max)
                    ->minDate(fn (callable $get) => $get('startDate'))
                    ->maxDate(now())

            ->columns(2);

    {
        $now = Carbon::now();

        return match ($preset) {

                Carbon::parse($this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->min)->toDateString(),
                Carbon::parse($this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->max)->toDateString(),
            ],
            // la settimana comincia di domenica
            'current_week' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfWeek(Carbon::SUNDAY)->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->startOfWeek(Carbon::SUNDAY)->addDays(6)->toDateString(),
            ],
            'current_month' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfMonth()->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->endOfMonth()->toDateString(),
            ],
            'current_year' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfYear()->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->endOfYear()->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_7_days' => [
                $now->copy()->subDays(6)->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_30_days' => [
                $now->copy()->subDays(29)->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_year' => [
                $now->copy()->subYear()->addDay()->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
        };
    }

    /**
     * Data della prima e dell'ultima attività registrata dall'utente,
     * usate come estremi preimpostati del filtro periodo.
     */
    protected function getUserActivitiesDateRange(): object
    {
        return once(fn () => Activity::query()
            ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->selectRaw('min(start_date_local) as min, max(start_date_local) as max')
            ->first());
    }
}

trait HasActivityPeriodFilter
{
    use HasFiltersForm {
        mountHasFilters as baseMountHasFilters;
    }

    /**
     * Livewire chiama il mount() esplicito del componente PRIMA degli hook
     * mount{Trait} (qui mountHasFilters, che ripristina i filtri dalla sessione/URL):
     * un mount() separato vedrebbe sempre $this->filters ancora vuoto e
     * sovrascriverebbe ogni personalizzazione ad ogni reload. Sovrascrivendo
     * direttamente mountHasFilters possiamo invocare prima il comportamento
     * originale del trait e solo dopo, se i campi risultano ancora vuoti,
     * applicare i default pre-calcolati (Filament applica il default di un
     * campo solo al primissimo fill "da zero": se la sessione contiene già
     * un filtro esplicito, anche vuoto, il default del campo non scatta più).
     */
    public function mountHasFilters(): void
    {
        $this->baseMountHasFilters();

        if (filled($this->filters['startDate'] ?? null) || filled($this->filters['endDate'] ?? null)) {
            return;
        }

        $range = $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange();

        $this->filters['startDate'] = $range->min;
        $this->filters['endDate'] = $range->max;

        $this->getFiltersForm()->fill($this->filters);

        if ($this->persistsFiltersInSession()) {

        }

    {
        return $form
            ->schema([
                Select::make('preset')
                    ->label('Periodo rapido')
                    ->placeholder('Personalizzato')
                    ->options([

                        'last_30_days' => 'Ultimi 30 giorni',
                        'last_year' => 'Ultimo anno',

                    ->live()
                    ->afterStateUpdated(function (?string $state, Set $set) {
                        if ($state === null) {
                            return;

                        [$start, $end] = $this->getPresetRange($state);

                        $set('startDate', $start);
                        $set('endDate', $end);

                    ->default(fn () => $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->min)

trait HasFilters
{
    /**
     * @var array<string, mixed> | null
     */
    #[Url]

    protected bool $persistsFiltersInSession = true;

    public function mountHasFilters(): void
    {
        $shouldPersistFiltersInSession = $this->persistsFiltersInSession();
        $filtersSessionKey = $this->getFiltersSessionKey();

        if (! count($this->filters ?? [])) {
            $this->filters = null;
        }

        if (
            ($this->filters === null) &&
            $shouldPersistFiltersInSession &&
            session()->has($filtersSessionKey)
        ) {
            $this->filters = session()->get($filtersSessionKey);
        }

        // https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/7999
        if ($this->filters) {
            $this->normalizeTableFilterValuesFromQueryString($this->filters);
        }

        if (method_exists($this, 'getFiltersForm')) {
            $this->getFiltersForm()->fill($this->filters);
        }

        if ($shouldPersistFiltersInSession) {
            session()->put(
                $filtersSessionKey,
                $this->filters,
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    protected function normalizeTableFilterValuesFromQueryString(array &$data): void
    {
        foreach ($data as &$value) {
            if (is_array($value)) {
                $this->normalizeTableFilterValuesFromQueryString($value);
            } elseif ($value === 'null') {
                $value = null;
            } elseif ($value === 'false') {
                $value = false;
            } elseif ($value === 'true') {
                $value = true;
            }
        }
    }

    public function updatedFilters(): void
    {
        if ($this->persistsFiltersInSession()) {
            session()->put(
                $this->getFiltersSessionKey(),
                $this->filters,
            );
        }
    }

    public function getFiltersSessionKey(): string
    {
        $livewire = md5($this::class);

        return "{$livewire}_filters";
    }

    public function persistsFiltersInSession(): bool
    {
        return $this->persistsFiltersInSession;
    }
}

{
    use InteractsWithPageFilters;

    protected static ?string $heading = 'Km per tipo di attività';

    protected static ?int $sort = 0;

    protected static ?string $maxHeight = '320px';

    /**

    private const MAX_BARS = 7;

    {
        return 'bar';

    protected function getData(): array
    {
        $bars = $this->getBars();

        if ($bars->isEmpty()) {

                'datasets' => [['data' => []]],
                'labels' => [],
            ];
        }

        return [

                ],
            ],
            'labels' => $bars->pluck('label')->all(),
        ];
    }

    protected function getOptions(): RawJs
    {
        return RawJs::make(<<<'JS'
            {
                indexAxis: 'y',
                scales: {
                    x: {
                        beginAtZero: true,
                    },
                    y: {
                        ticks: {
                            // km totale già visibile sull'etichetta della barra
                            callback: function (value, index) {
                                const label = this.getLabelForValue(value);
                                const km = this.chart.data.datasets[0].data[index];

                                return `${label} — ${km.toLocaleString('it-IT')} km`;
                            },
                        },
                    },
                },
                plugins: {
                    legend: {
                        display: false,
                    },
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: (context) => ` ${context.parsed.x.toLocaleString('it-IT')} km`,
                        },
                    },
                },
            }
        JS);
    }

    /**
     * Una riga per barra: km totali, etichetta e colore risolti da ActivityType.
     * Oltre MAX_BARS le code vengono accorpate in "Altro".
     *
     * @return Collection<int, array{km: float, label: string, color: string}>

    private function getBars(): Collection
    {
        $totals = Activity::query()
            ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->when(
                $this->filters['startDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '>=', $date)

            ->when(
                $this->filters['endDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '<=', $date)
            )
            ->selectRaw('type, COALESCE(SUM(distance), 0) as total')
            ->groupBy('type')
            ->pluck('total', 'type')
            ->sortDesc();

        $bars = $totals->map(function (mixed $total, ?string $type) {
            $activityType = $type !== null ? ActivityType::tryFrom($type) : null;

            return [
                'km' => round(((float) $total) / 1000, 1),
                'label' => $activityType?->getLabel() ?? 'Sconosciuto',

                'label' => 'Altro',
                'color' => $this->colorToRgb(Color::Gray),
            ]);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>  $color
     */
    private function colorToRgb(array $color): string
    {
        return "rgb({$color[500]})";
    }

namespace App\Filament\Widgets\Concerns;

use App\Enums\ActivityType;
use App\Models\Activity;
use Filament\Support\Colors\Color;
use Filament\Widgets\Concerns\InteractsWithPageFilters;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

/**
 * Query e raggruppamento per tipo, condivisi da tutti i grafici (a torta o a
 * barre) "per tipo di attività" della dashboard, filtrati per il periodo
 * selezionato. Ogni widget fornisce solo l'espressione SQL della metrica e
 * come trasformare il totale grezzo nel valore da mostrare.
 */
trait GroupsActivitiesByType
{
    use InteractsWithPageFilters;

    /**
     * Totale grezzo della metrica per tipo di attività, ordinato decrescente.
     *
     * @return Collection<int|string, mixed>
     */
    protected function getTypeTotals(string $selectExpression): Collection
    {
        return Activity::query()
            ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->when(
                $this->filters['startDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '>=', $date)
            )
            ->when(
                $this->filters['endDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '<=', $date)
            )
            ->selectRaw("type, {$selectExpression} as total")
            ->groupBy('type')
            ->pluck('total', 'type')
            ->sortDesc();
    }

    /**
     * Una riga per fetta/barra: valore (trasformato da $transform), etichetta
     * e colore risolti da ActivityType. Oltre $maxItems le code vengono
     * accorpate in "Altro", sommando i totali grezzi prima di trasformarli.
     *
     * @param  Collection<int|string, mixed>  $totals
     * @param  callable(mixed $rawTotal): mixed  $transform
     * @return Collection<int, array{value: mixed, label: string, color: string}>
     */
    protected function mapTypeTotalsToRows(Collection $totals, int $maxItems, callable $transform): Collection
    {
        $rows = $totals->map(function (mixed $total, int|string|null $type) use ($transform) {
            $activityType = $type !== null ? ActivityType::tryFrom((string) $type) : null;

            return [
                'value' => $transform($total),
                'label' => $activityType?->getLabel() ?? 'Sconosciuto',
                'color' => $this->colorToRgb($activityType?->getColor() ?? Color::Gray),
            ];
        })->values();

        if ($rows->count() <= $maxItems) {
            return $rows;
        }

        return $rows
            ->take($maxItems)
            ->push([
                'value' => $transform($totals->slice($maxItems)->sum()),
                'label' => 'Altro',
                'color' => $this->colorToRgb(Color::Gray),
            ]);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>  $color
     */
    protected function colorToRgb(array $color): string
    {
        return "rgb({$color[500]})";
    }
}

class TimeShareChartWidget extends ChartWidget
{
    use GroupsActivitiesByType;

    protected static ?string $heading = null;

    protected static ?string $maxHeight = '320px';

    /**
     * Oltre le fette più grandi il resto viene accorpato in "Altro",
     * altrimenti una torta con troppe fette diventa illeggibile.
     */
    private const MAX_SLICES = 7;

    protected function getType(): string
    {
        return 'pie';
    }

    protected function getData(): array
    {
        $slices = $this->getSlices();

        if ($slices->isEmpty()) {
            return [
                'datasets' => [['data' => []]],
                'labels' => [],
            ];
        }

        return [
            'datasets' => [
                [
                    'label' => 'Ore',
                    'data' => $slices->pluck('value.hours')->all(),
                    'backgroundColor' => $slices->pluck('color')->all(),
                    // bordo trasparente = 2px di superficie fra le fette, in entrambi i temi
                    'borderColor' => 'transparent',
                    'borderWidth' => 2,
                ],
            ],
            'labels' => $slices->pluck('label')->all(),
            'durations' => $slices->pluck('value.duration')->all(),
        ];
    }

    protected function getOptions(): RawJs
    {
        return RawJs::make(<<<'JS'
            {
                plugins: {
                    legend: {
                        position: 'right',
                        labels: {
                            boxWidth: 12,
                            boxHeight: 12,
                            usePointStyle: true,
                            pointStyle: 'circle',
                            // durata già visibile in legenda, senza dover passare il mouse
                            generateLabels: (chart) => {
                                const { labels, datasets, durations } = chart.data;

                                return labels.map((label, i) => ({
                                    text: `${label}: ${durations[i]}`,
                                    fillStyle: datasets[0].backgroundColor[i],
                                    strokeStyle: datasets[0].backgroundColor[i],
                                    pointStyle: 'circle',
                                    index: i,
                                }));
                            },
                        },
                    },
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: (context) => {
                                const total = context.dataset.data.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
                                const percentage = total ? (context.parsed / total * 100) : 0;
                                const duration = context.chart.data.durations[context.dataIndex];

                                return ` ${context.label}: ${duration} (${percentage.toFixed(1)}%)`;
                            },
                        },
                    },
                },
            }
        JS);
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, array{value: array{hours: float, duration: string}, label: string, color: string}>
     */
    private function getSlices(): Collection
    {
        $totals = $this->getTypeTotals('COALESCE(SUM(moving_time), 0)');

        return $this->mapTypeTotalsToRows(
            $totals,
            self::MAX_SLICES,
            function (mixed $total): array {
                $seconds = (int) $total;

                return [
                    'hours' => round($seconds / 3600, 2),
                    'duration' => $this->formatDuration($seconds),
                ];
            },
        );
    }

    private function formatDuration(int $seconds): string
    {
        $hours = intdiv($seconds, 3600);
        $minutes = intdiv($seconds % 3600, 60);

        return "{$hours} h {$minutes} min";
    }
}
